title: Almost-polynomial-factor NP-hardness of robust torus-orbit distance approximation

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard algorithmic integer linear algebra, singular-value bounds, and lattice CVP approximation/hardness results cited by the authors

core_obligations: Lift arbitrary lattices to projections of lattices with rational orthonormal bases.
Reduce CVP to subspace-to-cubic-lattice distance and then to all four robust torus-orbit problems.
difficulty_reason: Uses an effective quadratic-form Waring decomposition and rational orthogonal completion to construct lattice liftings, followed by approximation-preserving reductions. The source-local constructions and proofs remain included, not promoted into extra counted lemmas.
